clue.text: Write in quarters, retaining copy

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the compass points hold on to the copy, so it sits between them

parts.note: S and E, south and east, are two quarters of the compass
a crib is a copy cheated from someone else's work

explanation.surface: An instruction to write something into the four quarters of a page while keeping a copy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Write in' looks like the definition, but IN is wordplay; 'retaining' puts CRIB inside SE.
explanation.definitionFit: To inscribe is to engrave or put words down on a surface.

clue.text: A girl who's popular — and grating with it!

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
a grid is a grating of bars

explanation.surface: A fashionable girl who is also irritating.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grating' looks like 'irritating', but it is a lattice of bars.
explanation.definitionFit: Ingrid is a girl's first name.

clue.text: The odd trip is taken to show enterprise

indicators.note: odd means the letters of the words after it are made strange and rearranged

explanation.surface: An unusual journey shows initiative.
explanation.walkthrough: 'odd' rearranges TRIP IS; 'The', 'taken to show' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: Spirit is energy and initiative, much as enterprise is.

clue.text: A bit of a bounder — a scallywag, a rogue

indicators.note: a bit of means only part of the following run of words is taken

explanation.surface: A list of words for a cad and a scoundrel.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run from the end of 'bounder' through 'a' into 'scallywag'.
explanation.definitionFit: A rascal is a scamp or mischievous rogue.

clue.text: Though not the best man, he'll clinch the match

definitions.text: Though not the best man, he'll clinch the match

parts.words: Though not the best man, he'll clinch the match
parts.note: the best man is the groom's supporter at a wedding, and the match is the marriage rather than a sporting contest

explanation.definitionFit: The man getting married is the one who completes the marriage match.

clue.text: Stares wildly say

indicators.note: wildly tells us the letters of the word beside it are thrown about

explanation.surface: Someone stares wildly, for example.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wildly' rearranges STARES; 'say' looks like the usual 'for example' tag but is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To assert something is to state or declare it firmly.

clue.text: Bosses accepting financial commitments 17

definitions.note: refers to the answer at 17-down, meaning engaged in thought

indicators.note: the bosses take in the debts, holding them inside

parts.note: studs are bosses, raised knobs on a surface
an IOU is a note promising to pay a debt

explanation.surface: Managers taking on debts as they consider matters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bosses' looks like managers, but means studs, knobs on a shield or belt.
explanation.definitionFit: Studious means given to study and reflection.

clue.text: Unusual pieces, almost all outstanding

indicators.note: unusual signals the letters of pieces form something unexpected
almost means the last letter of all is dropped

explanation.surface: Odd pieces, nearly every one of them remarkable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Unusual' rearranges PIECES to ESPECI; 'almost' trims ALL to AL.
explanation.definitionFit: Especial means exceptional or particular.

clue.text: Note the revolutionary must be kept in check

parts.note: te is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale
taken as written
a red is a communist revolutionary

explanation.surface: Notice that the rebel must be restrained.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Note' looks like 'take notice', but is a musical note.
explanation.definitionFit: Tethered means tied up and restrained.

clue.text: Winnings are of some help. This will be denied

parts.note: gains are winnings or profits
aid means help

explanation.surface: Prize money is some help, but a claim to it will be refused.
explanation.definitionFit: Something gainsaid has been contradicted or refused, as a denied statement is.

clue.text: Figure on getting a little dog to dote on

parts.note: a pup is a young dog
to pet someone is to fondle or dote on them

explanation.surface: A figurine of a small dog for someone to adore.
explanation.definitionFit: A puppet is a figure worked by strings or a hand inside it.

clue.text: Did like it — made it new fashion

indicators.note: to fashion something anew is to remake it, so the letters are reshaped

explanation.surface: Someone enjoyed something and turned it into a new trend.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Did like' looks like 'enjoyed', but means 'copied'; 'new fashion' rearranges IT and MADE IT.
explanation.definitionFit: To have imitated is to have done as another did, copying them.

clue.text: The never-ending round

parts.note: a tedious routine that never stops, or a shape with no end going round

explanation.definitionFit: A ring-shaped figure has no end point however far you trace it.

clue.text: Trees to come down before any others

parts.note: firs are coniferous trees
taken as written
to fall is to come down

explanation.surface: Trees to be felled ahead of the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: First of all means at the very start, ahead of everything else.

clue.text: Make the connection clear

definitions.meaning: to join by a hinge or joint, as bones meet

explanation.definitionFit: A jointed limb is articulated, and articulate speech is lucid and well expressed.

clue.text: Act in a less restrained way and cause confusion

definitions.text: Act in a less restrained way
definitions.meaning: split as two words: behave more unruly

explanation.definitionFit: Taken in two words it means becoming more unruly; as one word it means to baffle.

clue.text: Collected work on paper?

parts.note: a gathered body of written output, as an author's collected pieces

explanation.definitionFit: Writings are the written works of an author, put down on paper.

clue.text: Having a fixation about family consideration

indicators.note: the word for fixation goes around the word for family

parts.note: to have a thing about something is to be obsessed with it
kin are family members

explanation.surface: Being obsessed about family considerations.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Having a thing about' is the idiom for an obsession.
explanation.definitionFit: Thinking is thought or reflection on a matter.

clue.text: Giving a shout here damaged a souterrain

indicators.note: damaged means the letters of the words before it are broken up and rebuilt

explanation.surface: Someone shouting in an ancient underground chamber has damaged it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'damaged' rearranges A SHOUT HERE; 'Giving' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A souterrain is an underground passage or chamber of the Iron Age, also called by this name in Scotland.

clue.text: Gig on the box

parts.note: a gig is a light two-wheeled cart
taken as written

explanation.surface: A concert broadcast on television.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gig' looks like a concert and 'box' like television, but a gig is also a horse-drawn cart.
explanation.definitionFit: A carton is a cardboard box or container.

clue.text: Bit outside right to get through

indicators.note: the word for bit is placed round the letter for right

parts.note: a bit is a piece

explanation.surface: A piece placed outside on the right so as to get through.
explanation.definitionFit: To pierce something is to make a hole through it.

clue.text: Determine the position of eastern countries

definitions.meaning: to get one's bearings or align something
the lands of the East, Asia

explanation.definitionFit: To orient is to find direction; the Orient is an old name for Asia.

clue.text: Object if put into temporary accommodation

parts.note: something put into a place is in it
a tent is shelter put up for a short stay

explanation.surface: A complaint raised about being housed under canvas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Object' looks like a verb meaning protest, but here it is a noun meaning purpose.
explanation.definitionFit: An intent is an aim or purpose, as is an object.

clue.text: Frenchman to whom duty is of the greatest importance

definitions.text: Frenchman to whom duty is of the greatest importance

parts.words: Frenchman to whom duty is of the greatest importance
parts.note: duty here is customs duty, not moral obligation, so this is a French official collecting it

explanation.definitionFit: A douanier is a French customs officer, whose job is levying tax on imports.

clue.text: He sinned when coming back

indicators.note: coming back means the word sinned is read from end to start

explanation.surface: A man who did wrong on his return.
explanation.walkthrough: 'He' is the definition: a man's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Dennis is a man's first name, so a male person.

clue.text: Some go wrong with key arrangement of flower-beds

parts.note: part means some
to err is to go wrong
E is a musical key

explanation.surface: Some flower-beds are wrongly laid out in a key design.
explanation.definitionFit: A parterre is a formal garden of ornamental beds laid out in a pattern.

clue.text: Concerned with token yield

parts.note: re means about or concerning
a sign is a token or indication

explanation.surface: Someone involved with a token surrender.
explanation.definitionFit: To resign is to give up or surrender, as one yields.

clue.text: Most offensive about conservationists, and most outspoken

indicators.note: the word for most offensive goes around the conservation body

parts.note: bluest means most indecent or smutty
NT is the National Trust, a British conservation charity

explanation.surface: A remark about environmentalists that is both the rudest and the frankest.
explanation.walkthrough: BLUE jokes are smutty ones; NT is the National Trust, which looks after historic houses and land in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: Being blunt means speaking frankly without tact.
